title: debug-display-placeholder + attribute-aware member-could-be-private
summary: Warning (OFF in 1.52) on a DebuggerDisplay placeholder naming no member; member-could-be-private reads attributes from the index
intro: Read this to see what debug-display-placeholder reports, when it stays silent, and how member-could-be-private now uses the attributes index fact instead of the source line.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint <file> --rule debug-display-placeholder --db <db> (default OFF in 1.52; a [DebuggerDisplay('..{Name}..')] placeholder naming no member of the type, read from the attributes index fact; category bug-patterns, warning)
